newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL ISSUE PRICE $16.25 PER SHARE - APV.
newsitem.headline: MOL ISSUE PRICE $16.25 PER SHARE - APV.

text.p: The subscription price in the next selloff phase of Hungarian oil and gas company MOL Rt has been set at $16.25 per share, privatisation agency APV Rt said in a statement on Tuesday.

APV said it has offered 12.3 million shares or a 12.5 percent stake in MOL internationally, with a 2.5 percent over-allotment option, and a one percent stake with a three percent over-allotment option domestically.
"The international private placement has been nearly six times oversubscribed," Gabor Hegyi, an official of the public relations agency retained by APV told Reuters.
APV said the domestic price would be 2,970 Hungarian forints. The domestic placement starts on May 12, the statement said.
